answer: Cap new identities per network: at most five fresh identities from one ASN earn full rewards in one epoch, and the rest wait in queue. A farm of 1,000 fake identities run from one datacenter would need 200 separate networks, each with rented machines and paid upkeep, to clear the cap in one epoch. Through that prism, an ocean of new accounts resolves to a handful of sources, and the nectar of cheap mass registration costs the farm network by network.
